details: Battery Vehicles & Wheelchairs: Battery-operated buggies and wheelchairs are provided by Srisaila Devasthanam for elderly and differently-abled devotees near the CRO and main gopuram entry.
Priority Darshan Line: Dedicated queue lines and priority access counters are available for Senior Citizens and Divyangjan upon producing age/disability proof.
Patalaganga Ropeway: Ropeway / Cable car service is available for elderly devotees to reach the Patalaganga Krishna River bathing ghats without descending the 500 stone steps.
